cost.note: Elapsed times rate is a reference, not an invoice; all prior caps remain reserved conservatively.

throughput.note: Aggregate throughput includes all three sources and four workers; not isolated search latency, process CPU seconds or GPU training speed.

limitations: Max 64 plies; truncated games do not acquire natural win/loss labels.
Search scores are material/terminal units, not win probabilities or proof of optimal play.
Pilots and production overlap; do not sum eligible counts as independent samples.
Cross-OS/CPU byte reproducibility is not established.
No CUDA training or M6 trained-model evaluation was performed.
